_schema_note: Reference data only -- not yet consumed by the rule engine's DSL (no get_exemption_threshold() registry function exists; wiring this in is future work, not done in this pass, since two of these thresholds are not yet confirmed against the actual gazette). commodity.is_exempt in the extraction contract is currently set upstream of the engine (e.g. by the API caller / CV commodity classifier), not derived from this file.

exemptions.description: Net quantity <=10 g or <=10 ml is fully exempt from Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules labeling.
exemptions.source: research/mainResearch/Product Categories, Exceptions & Decision Logic.docx, cited therein as 'LMPC Rule 26(a)'
exemptions.note: The docx's own 'Rule 26(a)' citation is unconfirmed against the actual gazette -- CLAUDE.md flags this research set as containing simulated/uncertain citations elsewhere, so this one is not trusted until independently verified.

exemptions.description: Net quantity 10-20 g/ml: proviso -- MRP and net quantity must still be shown even though otherwise exempt.
Packaged fast food sold by hotels/restaurants for immediate consumption: exempt from MRP/net-weight declaration.
Scheduled medicines under the Drugs (Prices Control) Order (DPCO): exempt from LMPC labeling.
Agricultural produce packages exceeding 50 kg: exempt.
Loose (non-prepackaged) garments/goods are not a 'pre-packaged commodity' -- LMPC declarations not required; advisory-only tagging (name, size, MRP, maker) recommended.
LPG cylinders: no manufacturing month-year and no retail-price declaration required.
exemptions.note: Already load-bearing and in production use: packages/rules/lmd_rules.v1.json rule LM-C05's applicable_when excludes commodity.category == 'lpg_cylinder' from the manufacturing-date completeness check.

exemptions.description: Bidi and incense sticks: no manufacturing-date declaration required.
exemptions.note: Already load-bearing: LM-C05's applicable_when also excludes commodity.category IN ['bidi', 'incense_sticks'].

exemptions.description: Wholesale packages (cartons of multiple retail units) only need manufacturer/importer identity, commodity identity, and total count or weight -- not full retail declarations.
Alcoholic beverages: Legal Metrology price/date declaration rules are not enforced (governed by excise law instead).
exemptions.note: Already load-bearing: LM-C02's applicable_when excludes commodity.category == 'alcoholic_beverage'.
